fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Fires at a target at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 9 tiles.

fusions.name: Flush and Mark
fusions.desc: You close up to 7 tiles on the target and fire point-blank, dealing 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stalking Party
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds, moving 10% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
